title: zippered velvet pillow shams
text:
zippered velvet pillow shams. I purchased three different shams. I have some obnoxious thick memory foam pillows and they are hard to put into any shams - but I easily got them in these. The zippers are on the long way - not the ends , which helps. They are velvety and soft. In my opinion they are a medium gray. They machine washing and dried nicely. So far, of the three different types I purchased, these are my favorites. Having said all of this, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
UPDATE: I went back to purchase the chamois color for my Autumn quilt. Wish they offered a burnt orange or a deep olive. But these will work. Good quality. I use them daily (I have a gray pair too) and they hold up in the wash/dry. Happy with my purchases.
